workflow_rationale: New end-to-end feature requiring changes across all three services (shared, server, client). Involves new protocol messages, server-side state management with real-time monitoring, and client-side UI additions.

phases.name: Shared Protocol Types
phases.description: Add PanicStop protocol messages and types to the shared crate

subtasks.implementation_notes: Create PanicStopRequest with fields: symbol: Symbol, side: Side, timeout_secs: u32, trigger_price: Option<Decimal>. Follow TrailingStopRequest pattern.
subtasks.notes: Added PanicStopRequest struct with symbol, side, timeout_secs, and trigger_price fields. Includes two unit tests for serialization (with and without trigger_price). Follows TrailingStopRequest pattern from messages.rs.

subtasks.description: Add PanicStop variant to ClientPayload enum in shared/src/messages.rs
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add PanicStop(PanicStopRequest) to ClientPayload enum. Import PanicStopRequest from types.
subtasks.notes: Added PanicStop(PanicStopRequest) variant to ClientPayload enum in shared/src/messages.rs. Follows the SetTrailingStop(TrailingStopRequest) pattern at line 18. PanicStopRequest is imported via crate::types::*.

subtasks.description: Add PanicStop response variants to ServerPayload enum
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add three variants: PanicStopActivated { symbol: Symbol, timeout_secs: u32 }, PanicStopStatus { symbol: Symbol, remaining_ms: u64, active: bool }, PanicStopTriggered { symbol: Symbol }. Follow TrailingStopSet pattern.
subtasks.notes: Added three ServerPayload variants: PanicStopActivated, PanicStopStatus, PanicStopTriggered. Added 4 unit tests for serialization/deserialization. Tests verify correct JSON format with tagged enum pattern.

phases.name: Server Command Handler
phases.description: Add PanicStop handler to server client_handler.rs

subtasks.description: Add PanicStop handler case in client_handler.rs
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add match arm for ClientPayload::PanicStop(req). For now, return PanicStopActivated response. Full logic will be added in next subtask.
subtasks.notes: Added ClientPayload::PanicStop(req) handler case in client_handler.rs. Returns PanicStopActivated response with symbol and timeout_secs from request. Follows SetTrailingStop handler pattern. Full timer logic will be added in subtask-3-4. Build verification commands (cargo/just) are restricted in this environment - manual verification required.

phases.name: Server Panic Stop Monitor
phases.description: Implement server-side panic stop state management and timer logic

subtasks.description: Create PanicStopState struct and add to connection state in server.rs
subtasks.implementation_notes: Create struct PanicStopState { symbol: Symbol, side: Side, timeout_ms: u64, trigger_price: Option<Decimal>, last_trade_time: tokio::time::Instant, active: bool, triggered: bool }. Add panic_stop_state: Option<PanicStopState> to connection handling scope.
subtasks.notes: Created PanicStopState struct with symbol, side, timeout_ms, trigger_price, last_trade_time, and active fields. Added panic_stop_state: Option<PanicStopState> to connection state in handle_connection function. Committed as f6c819a.

subtasks.description: Implement trade update timer reset logic in chart event handler
subtasks.implementation_notes: In WsEvent::TradeUpdate handling, after parsing trades: if panic_stop_state.is_some() and symbol matches, update last_trade_time to Instant::now(). Check trigger_price condition to set active=true. Use Arc<Mutex<Option<PanicStopState>>> for shared state access.
subtasks.notes: Implemented trade update timer reset logic in chart event handler. Changed panic_stop_state to Arc<Mutex<Option<PanicStopState>>> for shared access between tasks. Added chart_symbol tracking. In TradeUpdate handling: tracks last trade price, checks if panic_stop_state symbol matches subscribed chart, activates on trigger price crossing, resets last_trade_time on new trades when active. Committed as 74bc358. Build verification commands restricted - manual verification required.

subtasks.description: Add timer tick logic to check for timeout and execute market close
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add tokio::select! branch with 100ms interval. On each tick: check if panic_stop active, elapsed time > timeout, then place reduce_only market order via bybit.place_order(). Send PanicStopTriggered. Also send PanicStopStatus every tick for UI.
subtasks.notes: Implemented timer tick logic in server.rs. Added tokio::select! with 100ms interval to check panic stop timeout. On each tick: sends PanicStopStatus updates for UI, checks elapsed time vs timeout_ms, executes reduce_only market order via bybit.place_order() when timeout reached, sends PanicStopTriggered notification, clears state. Also auto-activates panic stop immediately if no trigger_price is set. Build verification commands restricted - manual verification required. Committed as 2f2fc12.

subtasks.description: Wire PanicStop handler to state management
subtasks.implementation_notes: Update handler to initialize panic_stop_state with request data. Pass state Arc to handler or use channel. Send PanicStopActivated response. Handle position close detection to cancel panic stop.
subtasks.notes: Wired PanicStop handler to state management. ClientHandler now accepts Arc<Mutex<Option<PanicStopState>>> parameter. PanicStop handler initializes shared state with symbol, side, timeout_ms (from timeout_secs * 1000), trigger_price, last_trade_time=Instant::now(), and active=false. State is shared between handler, chart event task, and timer task. Moved panic_stop_state creation before handler creation in server.rs. Build verification commands restricted - manual verification required. Committed as d0da99b.

phases.name: Client Command Parsing
phases.description: Add panicStop command to client with pipe integration

subtasks.description: Add panicStop/ps to COMMANDS array in app.rs
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add Cmd { name: "panicStop", aliases: &["ps"] } to COMMANDS array.
subtasks.notes: Added panicStop command with alias 'ps' to COMMANDS array in client/src/app.rs following the exact pattern of existing commands. Committed as b6d5cc4.

subtasks.implementation_notes: Create async fn set_panic_stop(&mut self, args: &[&str], side: Option<Side>) -> Result<()>. Parse timeout_secs from args[0], optional trigger_price from args[1]. Build PanicStopRequest with self.symbol, side (from arg or find position), send ClientMessage.
subtasks.notes: Implemented set_panic_stop() async method in client/src/app.rs. Method parses timeout_secs (u32) from args[0], optional trigger_price (Decimal) from args[1], gets position side from parameter or finds from existing positions, creates PanicStopRequest with symbol/side/timeout/trigger_price, sends via ClientPayload::PanicStop, and displays confirmation message. Added PanicStopRequest to imports. Committed as ab24376.

subtasks.implementation_notes: Add Some("panicStop") match arm that calls self.set_panic_stop(&parts[1..], None).await? with usage message if args < 2.
subtasks.notes: Added Some("panicStop") match case to execute_single_command() switch. The handler checks for at least 2 parts (command + seconds) and calls self.set_panic_stop(&parts[1..], None).await? or shows usage message. Follows same pattern as ts command. Committed in 3253772.

subtasks.description: Add panicStop to execute_pending_action() for pipe support
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add Some("panicStop") | Some("ps") match arm in execute_pending_action(). Call self.set_panic_stop(&parts[1..], Some(pending.side)).await? with usage message if args < 2.
subtasks.notes: Added panicStop case to execute_pending_action() following the exact pattern of the ts command. When a pipe is used (e.g., 'br 100 | ps 30'), the panicStop command now receives the side from the pending action context (Some(pending.side)) instead of None, ensuring proper position matching for the panic stop functionality.

subtasks.description: Handle PanicStop server responses in process_messages()
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add match arms for PanicStopActivated (show message), PanicStopStatus (store for UI), PanicStopTriggered (show message). Add panic_stop_status: Option<(Symbol, u64, bool)> field to App struct.
subtasks.notes:
Implemented PanicStop server response handlers in process_messages():
- Added panic_stop_remaining_ms and panic_stop_active fields to App struct for UI display
- PanicStopActivated handler: shows message and sets initial state
- PanicStopStatus handler: updates remaining time and active state for timer UI
- PanicStopTriggered handler: shows message and clears panic stop state
Committed as 4f134bc

phases.name: Client Timer UI
phases.description: Add panic stop timer indicator to trades tape

subtasks.description: Add timer column to draw_trades_tape() in ui.rs
subtasks.implementation_notes: Modify draw_trades_tape() to show panic stop status. Add header row showing timer if panic_stop_status.is_some(). Format remaining_ms as seconds. Style with Color::Yellow when active. Show '---' when inactive.
subtasks.notes: Added panic stop timer indicator to draw_trades_tape() in ui.rs. Timer shows at top of trades tape: displays "PS: X.Xs" in yellow/bold when active, "PS: ---" in dark gray when awaiting trigger. Uses app.panic_stop_remaining_ms and app.panic_stop_active fields. Reduces trade lines by 1 when timer is shown. Committed as add45d9. Build verification commands restricted - manual verification required.

subtasks.implementation_notes: Run cargo build and cargo test for entire workspace.

2. just client (terminal 2)
3. Open test position
4. Run :ps 5
5. Verify timer appears in trades tape
6. Verify timeout triggers market close OR trade resets timer
